title: Aquarium
empty: No one is swimming here yet.

legend.title: How to read the aquarium
legend.size: Bigger = more chats, projects and tokens (the busiest person is the biggest)
legend.speed: Faster = more tokens in the last 24 h
legend.followers: Little followers = the profiles they use, named on their chip
legend.active: Glow and bubbles = working right now
legend.show: Show how to read the aquarium
legend.hide: Hide how to read the aquarium

play.title: Try this
play.tapMouse: Click anywhere: your creature swims there
play.tapTouch: Tap anywhere: your creature swims there
play.shakeMouse: Press Shake: everyone changes direction and speed
play.shakeTouch: Shake your phone (or press Shake): everyone changes direction and speed
play.motionDenied: Shaking the phone is off. Use the Shake button.
play.noSelf: You don't have a creature here yet.
play.shaken: Everyone is swimming a new way.
